exercises.title: try/catch: a calculator that never crashes
exercises.problemHtml:
Read lines until the end of input. Each line should be two integers a b; print a / b (integer division) and a % b:

17 / 5 = 3 remainder 2

Never crash. Instead print exactly one of:

  • Line 3: "x 2" is not two integers — a part is not an integer, or the count of parts is not 2;
  • Line 4: cannot divide by zero.

Count every line in a finally block, and at the end print Processed 5 line(s), 2 error(s). Blank lines count too (as "not two integers").

Run the grader on your machine

The website does NOT grade this exercise. Press Tải .zip (download) above the code, unzip it, edit the code in src/, then inside the exercise folder (the one with cham.mjs) run:

node cham.mjs

The zip unpacks into a folder named after the exercise (<folder> below). Windows (PowerShell): cd "$env:USERPROFILE\Downloads\<folder>" — cmd: cd /d %USERPROFILE%\Downloads\<folder> — then node cham.mjs. macOS (Terminal): cd ~/Downloads/<folder> then node cham.mjs. Tip: type cd and drag the folder into the terminal window. You need Node.js 18+ and JDK 8 or newer (17 or 21 recommended) — javac -version must work.

The grader compiles src/ with javac, runs 3 case(s) (2 hidden — not printed in this text), compares your output line by line (trailing spaces and Windows/macOS line endings ignored), prints a diff of the wrong lines, checks the source rules and gives a score. When it prints ALL CHECKS PASSED, come back and press Tự đánh dấu đã giải (self-mark as solved). node cham.mjs --case 2 --show prints the input and your whole output for case 2.

Requirements

  • Catch the specific exceptions (NumberFormatException, ArithmeticException) — not Exception.
  • The line counter is incremented in finally.
exercises.problemHtmlVi:
Đọc các dòng tới hết input. Mỗi dòng phải là hai số nguyên a b; in a / b (chia nguyên) và a % b như mẫu. Không bao giờ sập; thay vào đó in đúng một trong hai: Line 3: "x 2" is not two integers (một phần không phải số nguyên, hoặc số phần khác 2) hoặc Line 4: cannot divide by zero. Đếm mọi dòng trong khối finally, cuối cùng in Processed 5 line(s), 2 error(s). Dòng trống cũng tính (là "not two integers").

exercises.title: throw with a reason: a constructor that refuses bad data
exercises.problemHtml:
A Product that cannot exist in a bad state: the constructor checks its arguments and throws IllegalArgumentException with a message that says what is wrong:

  • code: two upper-case letters + 3 digits ("SP001") → "code must look like SP001: <code>";
  • name: not blank → "name must not be blank";
  • price: ≥ 0 → "price must be >= 0: <price>";
  • quantity: 0..10 000 → "quantity must be 0..10000: <q>".

Check in that order (the first problem wins). setPrice applies the same price rule. The test class creates products and prints the message of each refusal.

Run the grader on your machine

The website does NOT grade this exercise. Press Tải .zip (download) above the code, unzip it, edit the code in src/, then inside the exercise folder (the one with cham.mjs) run:

node cham.mjs

The zip unpacks into a folder named after the exercise (<folder> below). Windows (PowerShell): cd "$env:USERPROFILE\Downloads\<folder>" — cmd: cd /d %USERPROFILE%\Downloads\<folder> — then node cham.mjs. macOS (Terminal): cd ~/Downloads/<folder> then node cham.mjs. Tip: type cd and drag the folder into the terminal window. You need Node.js 18+ and JDK 8 or newer (17 or 21 recommended) — javac -version must work.

The grader compiles src/ with javac, runs 3 case(s) (1 hidden — not printed in this text), compares your output line by line (trailing spaces and Windows/macOS line endings ignored), prints a diff of the wrong lines and gives a score. When it prints ALL CHECKS PASSED, come back and press Tự đánh dấu đã giải (self-mark as solved). node cham.mjs --case 2 --show prints the input and your whole output for case 2.

Requirements

  • Messages exactly as listed.
  • No object is created when a check fails (the exception leaves the constructor).

exercises.title: A custom checked exception: InsufficientFundsException
exercises.problemHtml:
Withdrawing more than the balance is a business error the caller must handle, so it is a checked exception.

  • InsufficientFundsException extends Exception with getShortfall() (how much is missing) and the message "need 300000 more".
  • Wallet.pay(long amount) throws InsufficientFundsException — a non-positive amount throws IllegalArgumentException("amount must be positive") (unchecked: a programming error).
  • Checkout.buy(Wallet w, String item, long price) returns "bought Pen" or catches the checked exception and returns "cannot buy Pen: need 300000 more (balance 200000)".

Run the grader on your machine

The website does NOT grade this exercise. Press Tải .zip (download) above the code, unzip it, edit the code in src/, then inside the exercise folder (the one with cham.mjs) run:

node cham.mjs

The zip unpacks into a folder named after the exercise (<folder> below). Windows (PowerShell): cd "$env:USERPROFILE\Downloads\<folder>" — cmd: cd /d %USERPROFILE%\Downloads\<folder> — then node cham.mjs. macOS (Terminal): cd ~/Downloads/<folder> then node cham.mjs. Tip: type cd and drag the folder into the terminal window. You need Node.js 18+ and JDK 8 or newer (17 or 21 recommended) — javac -version must work.

The grader compiles src/ with javac, runs 2 case(s) (1 hidden — not printed in this text), compares your output line by line (trailing spaces and Windows/macOS line endings ignored), prints a diff of the wrong lines, checks the source rules and gives a score. When it prints ALL CHECKS PASSED, come back and press Tự đánh dấu đã giải (self-mark as solved). node cham.mjs --case 2 --show prints the input and your whole output for case 2.

Requirements

  • The exception is checked (extends Exception, not RuntimeException).
  • pay declares throws InsufficientFundsException.

  • Checkout.buy(Wallet w, String item, long price) trả "bought Pen" hoặc bắt ngoại lệ checked và trả "cannot buy Pen: need 300000 more (balance 200000)".

exercises.title: finally and try-with-resources: close it no matter what
exercises.problemHtml:
Resource is given: it implements AutoCloseable and logs open A / close A. Write Job.run(String[] steps):

  • open two resources "DB" and "FILE" in one try-with-resources;
  • for each step call db.use(step) — a step named "boom" throws IllegalStateException;
  • catch it after the resources are closed and log "failed: <message>"; finally log "done".

The log must show that both resources are closed — in reverse order (FILE, then DB) — even when a step fails.

Run the grader on your machine

The website does NOT grade this exercise. Press Tải .zip (download) above the code, unzip it, edit the code in src/, then inside the exercise folder (the one with cham.mjs) run:

node cham.mjs

The zip unpacks into a folder named after the exercise (<folder> below). Windows (PowerShell): cd "$env:USERPROFILE\Downloads\<folder>" — cmd: cd /d %USERPROFILE%\Downloads\<folder> — then node cham.mjs. macOS (Terminal): cd ~/Downloads/<folder> then node cham.mjs. Tip: type cd and drag the folder into the terminal window. You need Node.js 18+ and JDK 8 or newer (17 or 21 recommended) — javac -version must work.

The grader compiles src/ with javac, runs 3 case(s) (1 hidden — not printed in this text), compares your output line by line (trailing spaces and Windows/macOS line endings ignored), prints a diff of the wrong lines, checks the source rules and gives a score. When it prints ALL CHECKS PASSED, come back and press Tự đánh dấu đã giải (self-mark as solved). node cham.mjs --case 2 --show prints the input and your whole output for case 2.

Requirements

  • Use try-with-resources (no manual close()).
  • Do not change Resource.java.
exercises.problemHtmlVi:
Resource cho sẵn: cài AutoCloseable và ghi log open A / close A. Viết Job.run(String[] steps): mở hai tài nguyên "DB" và "FILE" trong một try-with-resources; với mỗi bước gọi db.use(step) — bước tên "boom" ném IllegalStateException; bắt nó sau khi tài nguyên đã đóng và ghi "failed: <message>"; cuối cùng ghi "done". Log phải cho thấy cả hai tài nguyên được đóng — theo thứ tự ngược (FILE rồi DB) — kể cả khi một bước lỗi.

Chạy máy chấm trên máy bạn

Website KHÔNG chấm bài này. Bấm Tải .zip ở khung code, giải nén, sửa code trong src/, rồi trong thư mục bài (thư mục chứa cham.mjs) chạy:

node cham.mjs

Giải nén ra một thư mục mang tên bài (gọi là <thư-mục>). Windows (PowerShell): cd "$env:USERPROFILE\Downloads\<thư-mục>" — cmd: cd /d %USERPROFILE%\Downloads\<thư-mục> — rồi node cham.mjs. macOS (Terminal): cd ~/Downloads/<thư-mục> rồi node cham.mjs. Mẹo: gõ cd rồi kéo thư mục vào cửa sổ terminal. Cần Node.js 18+ và JDK 8 trở lên (khuyên 17 hoặc 21) — javac -version phải chạy được.

Máy chấm biên dịch src/ bằng javac, chạy 3 ca (1 ca ẩn — không in trong đề), so output từng dòng (bỏ qua khoảng trắng cuối dòng và kiểu xuống dòng Windows/macOS), in diff dòng sai, soát luật mã nguồn rồi cho điểm. In ALL CHECKS PASSED ⇒ quay lại đây bấm Tự đánh dấu đã giải. node cham.mjs --case 2 --show in input và toàn bộ output của bạn cho ca 2.

Yêu cầu

  • Dùng try-with-resources (không tự gọi close()).
  • Không sửa Resource.java.

hintsJson: try (Resource db = …; Resource file = …) { … } — Java calls close() on both automatically, in reverse order of opening.|||try (Resource db = …; Resource file = …) { … } — Java tự gọi close() cho cả hai, theo thứ tự ngược với lúc mở.

A catch attached to a try-with-resources runs AFTER the resources are closed — look at the order in the log.|||catch gắn với try-with-resources chạy SAU khi tài nguyên đã đóng — nhìn thứ tự trong log.

exercises.solutionExplanationHtml: try-with-resources guarantees close() for every resource declared in its header, in reverse order, before any catch or finally of the same statement runs. It replaces the error-prone try/finally { close } pattern (and the Scanner/BufferedReader leaks it causes).
exercises.solutionExplanationHtmlVi: try-with-resources bảo đảm gọi close() cho mọi tài nguyên khai báo ở phần đầu, theo thứ tự ngược, trước khi catch hay finally của cùng câu lệnh chạy. Nó thay khuôn try/finally { close } dễ sai (và các vụ rò Scanner/BufferedReader mà khuôn đó gây ra).

mistakesJson.loi: Closing manually at the end of the try block — when a step throws, close() is never reached.|||Tự đóng ở cuối khối try — khi một bước ném ngoại lệ, close() không bao giờ được gọi.
Opening the resources outside the try parentheses — then they are not closed automatically.|||Mở tài nguyên bên ngoài ngoặc của try — khi đó chúng không được đóng tự động.
